summary: Iteration 2 full test of CineStream new features. Backend: 41 pytest passed, 1 skipped (pre-existing demote-last-admin skip) across new test_iter2_features.py (presence/live, views/top10, ads CRUD+auth+validation, sitemap, anime 404, One Piece ongoing) and the iteration-1 regression suite. Frontend (Playwright): footer has no admin link, /admin works; Live Now (12 items, 'N watching now'), Top10 movie/tv/anime (10 items each), 8 vibe chips -> /discover?vibe=id, vibe-decider-link scrolls to Decider, SEO block with 5 expandable FAQs, JSON-LD + keywords meta; Decider (drag swipe + buttons, 8 cards -> pick, Play href, Another) and 'Top Picks For You' row after reload; history -> 'Because you watched Fight Club'; Discover (Hyped Films title, rating/genre/era/length/lang chips update URL+results, type tv, sort top/new, load more 40->80); watch page watchers count; Ads admin UI (create image ad home_middle -> renders between Romance and Top Rated TV; create video preroll skip 3s -> countdown 3..0, skip -> iframe player, not shown again on next watch page; toggle disable -> slot gone; edit prefill+rename; delete both -> empty state); shadcn Switch checked = red rgb(230,10,21), unchecked = white/12%; admin tabs servers/ads/users; One Piece 12 range tabs (1-100 ... 1101-1180), ep 1100 -> next 1101; mobile 390px no horizontal overflow on home/discover/decider/watch; regressions (search, My List, share dialog, server drag-to-player & reorder) pass. No functional bugs found.

minor.issue: Unauthenticated, unthrottled and accepts arbitrary title/poster: anyone can script requests to push any title (with an attacker-chosen poster URL/title text) to #1 in the public Top 10 rows. Consider rate-limit per session/IP and resolving title/poster server-side from TMDB/AniList by id.

Same: client-supplied title/poster for 'watching' is shown publicly in Live Now; fake sessions can inject arbitrary titles/images. Presence is in-process memory (not shared across workers, lost on restart).

issues: Swipe card is tall; Loved/Not for me/Haven't seen buttons are below the fold, user must scroll down past the card to tap them

action_items: Optional hardening: rate-limit /api/views and /api/presence and derive title/poster server-side to prevent Top 10 / Live Now manipulation

Optional: HTML ad iframe uses srcDoc with sandbox 'allow-scripts allow-same-origin' -> ad script runs with the site origin (can read localStorage/Clerk session cookies/parent DOM). Drop allow-same-origin (most ad tags work without it) or serve ad HTML from a separate origin
Optional: on mobile, make Decider card shorter so answer buttons are visible without scrolling
critical_code_review_comments: AdSlot.jsx: srcDoc iframe + allow-scripts + allow-same-origin effectively removes the sandbox (same-origin with the app).
server.py top10: $group uses $last without a preceding $sort, so the item metadata picked is arbitrary (minor).
AdsManager error toast reads detail[0].msg; string details (404/403) fall back to generic 'Something went wrong' (minor).
Discover filter chip testids for 'Any/All' are 'filter-rating-' / 'filter-genre-' etc. (empty suffix) - consider 'filter-rating-any' for clarity.
